published.title: Jesus at the Feast of Dedication
published.summary: At the Feast of Dedication in Jerusalem, Jesus is asked whether he is the Christ. Some take up stones after his answer and try to seize him, but he escapes and goes beyond Jordan, where many believe in him.

published.title: Jesus Washes the Disciples' Feet
published.summary: During supper Jesus washes his disciples’ feet and tells them to serve one another. He identifies his betrayer with a morsel given to Judas, who leaves, and foretells that Peter will deny him three times.
